name: placement
kind: installation, replaces rule P' of version 4 by P'' (versions 3 / 4 rules S, T, D, B, M, F unchanged): four corrections of the poll-wait booking -- the hold value and its origin of counting, the reach of the wait-origin search, the identity of the barrier in the chain of failed polls, and failed polls kept out of the fold by an instruction between them. No converted instruction and no cycle changes; frozen before any replay with it
why: placement v4 last addendum (poll_residual): origin_hold_cycles = 3877 was a misreading and K5b passed for the wrong reason; the reach of 4 records had no measurement; on b300 the tracer's address of a SYNCS [R+URZ+imm] operand differs from that of [UR+imm] for the same barrier and the fold keys by it; an instruction the fold rejects between the inline poll and the loop's polls leaves the wait in the loop. poll_origin_basic v1 addendum: false result 7757 cycles after the poll's issue in every configuration; the wait on the first instruction waiting for the poll's barrier at 3-14 instructions behind it; with an LDS between, on that same branch.
data_seen_before_freezing: Everything in versions 1-4 and their addenda, the poll_residual analysis with the two counterfactual full-GPU replays (origin_hold_cycles 7754 and unlimited) and the traces of 19 full-GPU cases; poll_origin_basic v1 with its addendum, including the 2e705118 replay of its cells.

judge_v5.py was run once on the 2e705118 replay before this file was committed (a dry run of the judge): K5a, K6, K7 pass there, K5b and K5c fail (u.pollcute.k1024 replay 3877 against hardware 7753 per wait; the far and lds cells have the wait in the retry loop).

rules.P'' (converter fact): Poll fold unchanged (370bf919): which records are dropped does not change. Chain: for a poll record S of a warp whose result is ready, the maximal run of failed polls directly in front of it in the warp's poll order that address the same barrier with the same parity as S; `same barrier` compares the barrier word computed from the instruction's bracket operand (sum of the captured register values of the first executing lane plus the displacement, the word the converter already resolves the mbarrier object from; the tracer's memory-reference address only where a register value is not captured). The instructions between the polls of a chain do not matter. P1 = the first poll of the chain. If the chain is not empty, S is kept in the converted stream, P1's code address differs from S's, and P1 writes a dependency barrier b: W = the first record behind P1 in the traced stream, at most 16 records ahead and not behind S (S itself when S is the first), whose static wait mask contains b; the search ends without result at a record other than P1 that writes b. If W exists, S's mbarrier_wait row carries flag 0x200 and W's absolute code address (as in version 4). Otherwise no flag.
rules.P'' (ledger): As version 4, with the hold counted from the poll: while a warp is held by the pending result of a poll instance S that carries the wait origin, the cycles booked today under reasons beginning with barrier:SYNCS.PHASECHK for that pending result are booked, under the same reason, on the wait-origin address as long as the cycle is earlier than issue(S) + T, and where they are booked today from that cycle on. T = origin_hold_cycles = 7757 on both devices (poll_origin_basic v1 addendum; source poll_origin_basic.<device>.v1, evidence measured); absent or 0: the booking of today. Statistics only.

criteria.K5a: u.pollcute.k0, .k64, .k256 (both devices): at least 90 % of the replay's barrier:SYNCS.PHASECHK cycles on the readers of the inline try_waits, at most 1.0 cycle per wait on the pcs of the out-of-line loops (version 4, unchanged).
criteria.K5b (restated: version 4's K5b compared: u.pollcute.k1024 and u.pollfar8.k1024: the replay's barrier:SYNCS.PHASECHK cycles on the pcs where the hardware books at least 3000 cycles of long_scoreboard per wait are within 3 % of the hardware's long_scoreboard on those pcs (both sides the same per-warp normalisation, reference-a).
criteria.K5c: u.pollfar4.k64, u.pollfar8.k64, u.pollfar14.k64, u.pollfar.lds.k64: at least 90 % of the replay's barrier:SYNCS.PHASECHK cycles are on pcs where the hardware books at least 100 cycles of long_scoreboard per wait.
criteria.K6: Every probe cell of the thirteen sources (the twelve of version 4 and poll_origin_basic) has a ledger, exactly the cycles of the 2e705118 replay (placement-v4r1; poll_origin_basic's own replay) and the same total ledger residency.
criteria.K7: Scoreboard over the twelve sources of version 4: overall pc x class error not higher than placement-v4r1's on either device; no source's class error higher by more than 0.005.
criteria.K8 (full GPU, required): 500 / 500 cases complete on both sets and every case has the cycles of full-mio4 (cycles_equal: different 0).

decision: All criteria pass on a device: P'' stays there. A criterion fails because the implementation does not do what the rule says: corrected and repeated, stated in the addenda. Otherwise P'' is taken out (version 4's P' restored) and the addenda say so.
hypotheses_full_gpu: Not criteria. Per-pc error inside mbarrier-poll sites (16.13 / 35.60 points in full-place4) falls by up to about 3.8 / 13.8 points (poll_residual: cap 0.6 / 3.0, reach 2.75 / 3.27, barrier identity 0.11 / 5.66, instruction between the polls 0.38 / 1.93); in the six b300 cases whose traces show the address difference the poll wait moves to the inline readers. The 7.8 / 10.8 points that are not a matter of booking (total poll-site time, time on another wait of the kernel) do not move; class totals do not move.
not_installed_here: The 7757-cycle time-out as engine timing (a failed poll still costs the replay nothing; the leaf's cycles field stays 0 and its disagreement with the crossings cell is open); the out-of-line path beyond the time-out (beyond T the cycles stay on the traced run's pcs, the hardware has them on NANOSLEEP.SYNCS); the fold's own key (the fold still keys by the tracer's address: the stream is unchanged by this protocol); chains whose first waiter is more than 16 records behind the poll.
not_allowed: No value from another machine or from the literature; no full-GPU case used to choose a rule or a value (the reach 16 is the measured 14 rounded up to the search window of the analysis; the barrier semantics has no distance); no cell dropped after its replay is seen; criteria unchanged after freezing.
